content: शोधन {%a.%} (-नी|{%f.%}) [शुध्-णिच्-ल्यु ल्युट् वा] Purifying, cleansing <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-नम्@} .²1 .³({%a%}) Purifying, cleansing. .³({%b%}) Cleansing or washing of a wound. .²2 Correction, clearing away errors; (शपथं) करोतु परिषन्मध्ये शोधनार्थं ममैव च <ls>Rām. 7. 95. 6</ls>. .²3 Exact determination. .²4 Payment, discharge, acquittance. .²5 Expiation, atonement; अज्ञानभुक्तं तूत्तार्यं शोध्यं वाप्याशु शोधनैः <ls>Ms. 11. 160</ls>. .²6 Refining of metals. .²7 Retaliation, requital, punishment. .²8 Subtraction (in <ab>math.</ab>). .²9 Green vitriol. .²10 Feces, ordure. .²11 Removal, eradication; कण्टकानां च शोधनम् <ls>Ms. 1. 115</ls>. .{@-नः@} The lime.
